aiOverview.content: The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half is scheduled for Sunday, March 15, 2026, organized by New York Road Runners. Over 30,000 runners will travel from Brooklyn, across the Brooklyn Bridge, through Times Square, to a finish in Central Park. The race features a 13.1-mile route through New York City. Key 2026 Race Details: Date: Sunday, March 15, 2026. Start Time: The first wave of runners sets off around 7:00 a.m.. Course: Begins in Brooklyn (near Prospect Park/Brooklyn Museum) and finishes near West 68th Street in Central Park, Manhattan. Key Landmarks: Runners traverse the Brooklyn Bridge and run through Times Square. Streaming/Viewing: Coverage will be available on abc7NY.com and ESPN+ starting at 7 a.m. EST on March 15, 2026. abc7NY.com ESPN+ Capacity: Over 30,000 participants are expected. Entry and Eligibility: Entry Requirements: Entry is often secured through a drawing, charity partnership, or by meeting qualifying criteria from previous NYRR events (such as the 4-Out-of-6 program). NYRR Charity Partners: Participants can gain entry through official charity partners like the Sarcoma Foundation of America or Row New York. Sarcoma Foundation of America Row New York Impact on NYC: Street Closures: Extensive closures will occur in Brooklyn and Manhattan on Sunday morning, starting around the Brooklyn Museum, crossing the Brooklyn Bridge, and throughout downtown and midtown Manhattan. The race is known for being the premier half marathon in the United States and offers runners a unique chance to run through closed city streets, finishing inside central
